description: This file is a shell script that sets up and tests various behaviors of a Git repository, specifically focusing on commit reachability, ancestry, basis, range retrieval, and other Git operations. It constructs a commit graph, runs multiple test cases to verify Git command functionalities, and uses custom test helpers.

methods.name: run_all_modes
methods.description: Runs a specified Git command in multiple modes: default, with reachability, range, and other flags; compares output with expected results.
